content: Actual value of an initValue shall be interpreted according to the AutosarDataType A DataPrototype can be typed by either an Applica- tionDataType or else an ImplementationDataType . Therefore, the actual value of an initValue shall be interpreted according to the AutosarDataType that types the DataPrototype . That is, if the DataPrototype is typed by an ApplicationDataType , the value shall be interpreted as a physical value while, if the DataPrototype is typed by an ImplementationDataType , the value is to be interpreted as the direct numerical representation.
